system.name: GoodDiffusion
system.one_liner: Proactive copyright protection for diffusion bridge models: inputs with a valid sample-specific signature generate normally, unauthorized inputs only yield a warning image.

content.variant_note: left: a problem-then-fix pair of mini-schematics; right: a tilted landscape of image distributions with one thick generation trajectory per method
content.argues: Sample-specific signatures from a learnable network make unauthorized use end in a warning image, whereas static signatures can be recovered and watermarks do not stop generation.
content.subject: Static versus sample-specific signatures, and generation trajectories of four methods over a landscape of image distributions.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw competing methods as thick coloured trajectories over one landscape of distributions, baselines faded and the proposed method saturated and labelled, and back the claim with callouts carrying a red cross or a green check; put a problem-then-fix pair of mini-schematics beside it, joined by colour-coded block arrows.
lessons.suits: Generative-model papers where behaviour is best explained as paths between distributions, especially protection or control methods that need an authorized versus unauthorized contrast.

evidence: The trained DBM integrates two distinct diffusion bridges into a single network
GoodDiffusion provides early proactive control: the unauthorized user can only generate the warning image

summary: GoodDiffusion protects diffusion bridge models proactively: inputs with a valid sample-specific signature generate normally, while unauthorized inputs can only produce a warning image. Figure 1 has two stacked left panels and one large landscape. The panels contrast a static signature, which an attacker's optimization loop around a surrogate N* recovers and bypasses, with signatures from a Learnable Signature Network that vary across inputs and leave no universal surrogate. At right a tilted gradient slab holds hills of image distributions with photo stacks; thick arrows trace grey standard diffusion, pink watermarking, a blue authorized path to the target images and a red unauthorized path to a warning spike, with verdict callouts.
summary_zh: GoodDiffusion 主动保护扩散桥模型：带有效样本特异签名的输入正常生成，未授权输入只得警告图。图一左侧对比可被恢复的静态签名与逐样本签名，右侧分布地形图上用灰、粉、蓝、红箭头比较四条生成轨迹。
notes: Prior concept-schematic and side-by-side-contrast kept. Panels are counted as 3: two framed left panels plus the untitled landscape. The landscape tint is read as following generation time because the time arrow uses the same blue to orange-red gradient. The signature mosaics look illustrative rather than measured.
